  Ce gabarit s'affiche quand quelqu'un ouvre une PR sur le miroir GitHub. Il vit dans le
  dépôt GitLab et voyage avec le miroir : rien à maintenir des deux côtés.

## This repository is a mirror

Thanks for the contribution — and sorry for the wall of text before you have even
started.

**This GitHub repository is a mirror.** It is pushed from a self-hosted GitLab, which is
the only source of truth. Anything committed here is overwritten on the next sync, so a
pull request opened against it cannot be merged, however good it is.

GitHub offers no setting to turn pull requests off, so this pull request will be closed
automatically with a link back here. That is not a judgement on your work.

## Where to send it instead

Open a merge request on GitLab:

<https://gitlab.yg-devworks.com/yves/jigger>

Anyone can register on the instance. If you would rather not, open an **issue** here —
issues on this mirror are read and answered — describing the change, and it can be
carried over.

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Yves848/jigger/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for
what the code expects.
